design.observed: centered hero on a diagonal purple-to-blue gradient, H1 at roughly 56 px with a pale lavender gradient fill, white pill button with a lavender glow: three of the ai-tells template defaults in one frame

design.where: desktop-tiles/tile-01.png and desktop/frame-01.png (Why Choose Us, Our Features, Trusted by Thousands)
design.observed: the same three-equal-card row repeated three times at the same 24 px radius and the same soft shadow, with a colour emoji (rocket, lock, bolt, chart, handshake, star) where an icon or image would sit
h1, body and p all resolve to Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif and no webfont is loaded; the only scale is H1 ~56 px, H2 ~36 px, H3 ~18 px, body ~16 px
sections alternate white and a #f5f5fa lavender band with roughly 80 px of padding top and bottom, held consistently through the page and on mobile
the brand word and five nav links run past the 390 px edge; the fourth link reads as 'Abo' and the fifth is off-canvas

usability.observed: five labelled nav links top right, a one-line value statement, and a 'Get Started Today' pill button at roughly 200 x 48 px inside the first 900 px
nav does not wrap or collapse at 390 px: 'About' is clipped to 'Abo' at the right edge and 'Contact' is not visible, which implies horizontal overflow at the header
cards stack one per row at roughly 310 px wide with 16 px side gutters and 16 px body text at #777 on white; the H2s break onto two lines without clipping
a second call to action 'Sign Up Now' on the gradient band followed by a one-line footer; the path forward is visible at the end of the page as well as the top
images: 0, so there is no alt text to count either way; the only non-text marks are emoji in heading-adjacent spans

creativity.observed: the hero and closing band are the same gradient, pill button and centred headline; no concept links copy, layout or imagery beyond the gradient itself
running_animations 0, canvases 0, videos 0, custom_cursor false, libraries empty, ambient_motion false: no motion or interaction idea exists to carry the page
the feature and testimonial sections share one card component and differ only in the emoji and the heading; the layout could be swapped onto any brand unchanged

content.observed: the three Why Choose Us cards each carry the identical lorem ipsum sentence under Fast, Secure and Powerful
testimonials are three one-word headings ('Amazing!', 'Love it!', 'Wow!') with one-sentence quotes attributed to John D., Sarah K. and Mike R.; no company, role or outcome
170 words total; the hero copy is 'Unlock your potential with our innovative, cutting-edge platform that empowers teams to achieve more, faster' and the page never says what the product does
zero images on the page; every card uses a colour emoji where imagery would sit

design: Hero (desktop-tiles/tile-00.png): replace the purple-blue gradient and lavender gradient-filled H1 with a flat background and a single solid display colour, and load one display face (a grotesk or serif) for H1 and H2 so the page is not entirely Arial.

Cards (desktop-tiles/tile-01.png, desktop/frame-01.png): the Why Choose Us, Our Features and Trusted rows use the same card; give each section its own layout (a two-column feature list, a single wide quote) so the page is not three identical rows.
Icons (all card tiles): replace the six emoji with a consistent line-icon set or product screenshots at one size and one stroke weight.
Mobile header (mobile-tiles/tile-00.png): collapse the five links into a menu button at 390 px, or wrap them to a second row, so no label is clipped.
usability: Header at 390 px (mobile/frame-00.png): the nav overflows and 'About' clips to 'Abo'; collapse to a menu control or allow the links to wrap so no control is off-canvas.

Nav links (desktop/frame-00.png): the five labels are 15 px text with no hover or active state visible; increase their hit area to at least 44 px tall on mobile and give the current section a visible marker.
First screen (desktop/frame-00.png): 'Get Started Today' is the only action and it names no destination; say what happens next (free trial, demo, pricing) in or under the button.
creativity: Pick one idea native to the product (what 'future of work' means for this tool) and carry it through the hero imagery, the section layout and the copy; today nothing beyond the gradient repeats.
Replace the repeated three-card row with at least one section that shows the product itself (a screenshot, a short demo video or a diagram) so the page has a signature element.
If motion is added, limit it to one considered reveal or one pinned sequence rather than ambient effects; manifest.json shows none at present, so the static frame has to carry the idea.
content: Why Choose Us cards (text.md): replace the three identical lorem ipsum sentences with one specific claim each (a latency number, a compliance standard, an integration count).
Testimonials (desktop/frame-02.png): give each quote a full name, company and role, and a sentence about the outcome; drop the one-word 'Amazing!' style headings.
Hero and section intros (text.md): 'Unlock your potential' and 'seamless solutions for modern businesses' say nothing about the product; state what Nexora is and who it is for in the first line.
Imagery (manifest.json images: 0): add at least one real product image or illustration; emoji should not be the only visual content.

not_observed: hover and cursor-follow effects on nav links, buttons and cards
click interactions and page transitions between routes; whether the nav links and the two CTAs lead anywhere
real-device performance and scroll smoothness (headless, software GL)
mobile-tiles/tile-05.png is flagged suspect_blank and shows a 9 px white strip below the footer (page_height 4229, tile y 4220): a capture tail, not a design flaw
whether the mobile header can be scrolled horizontally to reach 'About' and 'Contact' or whether they are clipped outright
